ig_caption:
How many times did you say sorry today for simply being in the room?
It is not manners. It is a small payment, because part of you believes your seat was never paid for. On Samhain night, when the veil is thin, remember that love never charged you rent.
Comment OWE if you are ready to put the ledger down, and send this to someone who needs it tonight.
